status.description: found = discovered; drafted = cover letter ready; awaiting = form filled, waiting for student's yes; submitted; interview (incl. online assessments); offer; rejected; skipped

followUp.description: ~10 days after applying; dashboard flags when due

nextAction.description: One sentence telling the student exactly what to do; shown in 'Needs you'. Empty when nothing is needed.

notes.description: Dated log, e.g. '10/2 portal: Under Review'

category.description: Legacy free-text label. Use category_ids (taxonomy) in the hosted version.
